stages.name: Select 1
stages.en: Round 1 · Test F1 with matched hold / push trials

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The scene starts upright, before the selected operation.

stages.name: primary_approach
stages.en: The gripper approaches domino 1 (F1).

stages.name: primary_hold
stages.en: Keep domino 1 held inactive (F1=0) during the upstream push.

stages.name: root_approach
stages.en: The upstream gripper approaches the pusher.

stages.name: root_push
stages.en: The upstream gripper pushes the pusher; observe how the scene responds.

stages.name: root_retract
stages.en: The pushing gripper withdraws; the target remains held.

stages.name: observe
stages.en: Wait for physical settling; graph unchanged until the batch update.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Paired trial: same initial context, opposite target command.

stages.name: initial

stages.en: The gripper approaches the bell striker (B).

stages.name: primary_hold
stages.en: Keep the bell striker held inactive (B=0) during the upstream push.

stages.name: Bell verification
stages.en: Hold the striker: dominoes fall, but bell and lamp stay off.

scope: New seven-node physical simulation demonstration. All graph snapshots come from the frozen pixel/ACC discovery run; the extra bell hold is a separate physical verification. Not the paper aggregate and not evidence of calibration superiority.
presentation: English-only concise viewing cut. Original contact motion and graph pixels preserved; shortened explanation cards; explicit independent resets retained; long settling intervals labeled 6x. Not a real-time physics claim.
